subject: C32
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:83-96; harness.test.tsx:394-431: drafts for a running conversation remain keyed by its operation ID, but a real tenant/workspace switch retires that conversation (authority/harness_domain.rs:846-863). On returning, the core observes conversation=null; the composer reads NEXT and offers no way to recover the old conversation's draft. Reproduced A/B/A with renewed references and the retired conversation absent: the draft survives only in an inaccessible store entry, including after New investigation. The tests incorrectly restore the old live conversation. Acceptance: preserve an explicit recovery path for the exact draft after actual conversation retirement, with no authority restoration or automatic send; test the core's real return state.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:93-99, 183-195; harness.test.tsx:459-485: first-send startup still erases later edits. Reproduced: submit a question, edit NEXT while awaiting the starting snapshot, observe phase=starting (the visible box changes to the operation's empty draft), then type a newer edit there. On ready/admission, line 190 overwrites that newer edit with NEXT and line 191 clears NEXT; the newer text is lost. Acceptance: maintain one coherent composer revision across starting/ready/admission, or preserve both drafts explicitly; never overwrite newer text. Add a regression with edits on both sides of the starting snapshot, rather than jumping directly from no conversation to ready.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:164-179; copy.ts:replaced/endedBeforeReady: recovery status can still falsely claim an unsent message is in the visible box. With an existing draft for a replacement conversation, the conditional copy is skipped, fresh is cleared, and the original remains hidden in NEXT while the replacement draft is shown. Also, phase=ending clears fresh while live() still selects the current conversation's empty box, yet reports the original is still in it. Both cases reproduced. Acceptance: expose the exact unsent message through the visible composer or an explicit recovery control without replacing another draft or sending automatically, and make the status truthful for replacement, ending and ended states.

R4 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:140-160, 219: the ending continuation remains stage=ending while begin awaits clearHarness. The core publishes conversation=null during ClearHarness before returning its receipt (authority.rs:4388-4390); that snapshot re-enters begin and issues another start. Reproduced one Send producing two startHarness intents; a Busy refusal from the duplicate then clears the admitted continuation, so the original question is never sent. Acceptance: consume or advance the continuation before asynchronous clearing/starting, bind completions to that submission, and test a null clear snapshot arriving before its receipt. One Send must produce at most one start and one prompt delivery, with recoverable text on refusal.
